resetIntro: Clear this persona's memory and start a new roleplay. The persona definition, meme packs and knowledge base are not affected.
resetDesc: Select what to clear. The persona definition, meme packs and knowledge base are not affected.
progressDesc: Closing this dialog does not stop the task. It continues in the background.
groupGlobalHelp: All personas share this data. You must confirm again when you select it.

journal.name: Life journal
journal.desc: Journal, archives and autonomy records of this persona

self_memory.name: Self memory
self_memory.desc: This persona's own experiences, entities, relations and preferences

relationship.name: Favorability & relationships
relationship.desc: Favorability and relationship terms with all users

session_history.name: Current session history
session_history.desc: Context of sessions using this persona (not backed up)

scheduled_tasks.name: Scheduled tasks
scheduled_tasks.desc: Pending and paused tasks of this persona, marked as cancelled

global_group.name: Memory of all groups
global_group.desc: Memory graph and profiles of all groups and their members

global_user.name: Global profiles of all users
global_user.desc: Global memory and preferences of all users

globalConfirmDesc: All personas share group memory and global user profiles. After deletion, other personas forget this content too.
legacySelfKeyHint: This persona still has legacy self memory from before migration. It is cleared together with "Self memory".
backupHelp: Only the selected items are backed up. You can restore them in "Backup & restore". Each persona keeps at most 5 backups.
backupUnsupported: These items are not backed up: {names}
confirmNameLabel: Type the persona name "{name}" to confirm
runningHint: Closing this dialog does not stop the task.
vectorsHint: Data is restored and the AI is ready to use. Until vectors are rebuilt, memory search uses keywords only. You can close this dialog and let the task run in the background.
resumableDesc: The last vector rebuild was interrupted. You can continue it.
backupsHelp: Each persona keeps the 5 latest backups. When a 6th is created, the oldest is deleted.
deleteConfirmDesc: Backup "{file}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
restoreDesc: Select the items to restore. Each item clears the current data first, then imports the backup.
restoreOverwriteWarning: This current data is deleted before the backup is imported:
restoreOverwriteNote: Data of the same kind added after the backup will be lost.
restoreVectorUnknown: {count} texts need re-embedding, time cannot be estimated
restoreVectorHint: The AI is usable during the vector rebuild. You can close this dialog and let the task run in the background.
restoreModelNote: Vectors are always rebuilt with the current embedding model.
restoreNoItems: This backup has no items to restore
